assignment_workflow.actors: A is created_by/requester; B is exactly one distinct eligible assignee.
assignment_workflow.assignee_ids: Exactly one active B is required. Non-admin A may select only an existing descendant allowed by assignment_down_levels. SuperAdmin may select any active user except self.
assignment_workflow.requester_id: For assignment, requester_id and created_by remain A.
assignment_workflow.initial_review: draft -> pending_approval -> registered, or pending_approval -> revision_requested -> pending_approval.
assignment_workflow.execution: B starts registered manually or by first planning item progress above zero. Planning progress is weighted; 100 percent does not auto-complete.
assignment_workflow.completion: B requests completion, then A approves to completed or rejects back to in_progress with a required reason.
